verdict_logic.reject: >=1 critical fail backed by evidence (deterministic, or quoted by the judge); page-level answers to site-pattern rules cap at revise

rules.name: Googlebot no bloqueado
rules.question: ¿Googlebot puede acceder a la URL?
rules.pass_if: Pública, sin login; robots.txt, meta y cabeceras no bloquean a Googlebot.
rules.fail_if: Disallow en robots.txt, auth wall, o bloqueo por IP/user-agent a Googlebot.
rules.remediation: Permitir Googlebot. Probar con URL Inspection (el crawler de la auditoría no se identifica como Googlebot).
rules.official_quote: Google only indexes pages on the web that are accessible to the public and which don't block our crawler, Googlebot, from crawling them. If a page is made private, such as requiring a log-in to view it, Googlebot will not crawl it.

rules.name: HTTP 200
rules.question: ¿La página responde con un status 2xx?
rules.pass_if: HTTP 2xx.
rules.fail_if: 4xx o 5xx.
rules.remediation: Corregir el status. Los soft 404 los cubre IDX-03.
rules.official_quote: Google only indexes pages that are served with an HTTP 200 (success) status code. Client and server error pages aren't indexed.

rules.name: Contenido indexable
rules.question: ¿Hay texto en un formato que Google puede indexar?
rules.pass_if: El MC es texto indexable, en el HTML servido o tras renderizar JavaScript (Google renderiza las páginas 200).
rules.fail_if: El MC solo existe como imagen o en un formato no soportado, o no aparece ni tras renderizar.
rules.remediation: Poner el MC como texto. Si depende de JavaScript, comprobar el HTML renderizado con URL Inspection.
rules.official_quote: Once Googlebot can find and access a working page, Google checks the page for indexable content. Indexable content means: The textual content is in a file type that Google Search supports.

rules.name: Sin noindex accidental
rules.question: Si la URL debe rankear, ¿está permitida la indexación?
rules.pass_if: Ninguna directiva noindex (ni 'none') en meta robots, meta googlebot o X-Robots-Tag; o noindex intencional en una URL que no debe rankear.
rules.fail_if: noindex o none en una URL que se quiere publicar y rankear.
rules.remediation: Quitar noindex o confirmar que la URL no debe rankear.
rules.official_quote: When Googlebot crawls that page and extracts the tag or header, Google will drop that page entirely from Google Search results, regardless of whether other sites link to it.

rules.name: Canonical coherente
rules.question: ¿El canonical apunta a la versión que debe indexarse?
rules.pass_if: Self-canonical o canonical a URL equivalente correcta.
rules.fail_if: Canonical a una URL no equivalente, conflicto con hreflang, o canonical puesto por JavaScript distinto del del HTML.
rules.remediation: Unificar duplicados. Canonical = URL canónica real.
rules.official_quote: Do include a rel="canonical" link on the canonical page itself (also known as a self-referential canonical).

rules.name: Links crawlables
rules.question: ¿Los enlaces importantes son <a href> reales?
rules.pass_if: Navegación e internos con href.
rules.fail_if: Nav solo onClick / JS sin href.
rules.official_quote: Generally, Google can only crawl your link if it's an <a> HTML element (also known as anchor element) with an href attribute. Most links in other formats won't be parsed and extracted by Google's crawlers.

rules.name: No huérfana
rules.question: ¿Algún enlace interno apunta a esta URL?
rules.pass_if: ≥1 enlace interno desde una página crawlable.
rules.fail_if: URL solo en sitemap o aislada.
rules.official_quote: Every page you care about should have a link from at least one other page on your site.

rules.name: JS no esconde el MC
rules.question: ¿El contenido principal está disponible para Googlebot?
rules.pass_if: MC en HTML o JS renderizable según guía JS.
rules.fail_if: MC crítico solo en JS bloqueado o que Google no renderiza.
rules.remediation: SSR o HTML inicial con el MC.
rules.official_quote: If it marks the URL as disallowed, then Googlebot skips making an HTTP request to this URL and skips the URL. Google Search won't render JavaScript from blocked files or on blocked pages.

rules.name: Crawled — currently not indexed
rules.question: ¿Google crawló y decidió no indexar?
rules.pass_if: No aparece este reason, o hay justificación (dup controlado).
rules.fail_if: Crawled not indexed en URL que se quiere indexar.
rules.remediation: Si la URL importa: subir valor único o consolidar duplicados. Si no aporta: noindex o eliminar.
rules.official_quote: The page was crawled by Google but not indexed. It may or may not be indexed in the future; no need to resubmit this URL for crawling.

rules.name: Discovered — currently not indexed
rules.question: ¿Está descubierta pero no crawlada?
rules.pass_if: No, o el sitio no prioriza esa URL a propósito.
rules.fail_if: Descubierta y nunca crawlada en URLs importantes.
rules.remediation: Mejorar enlaces internos + sitemap + calidad general del sitio (crawl budget).
rules.official_quote: The page was found by Google, but not crawled yet. Typically, Google wanted to crawl the URL but this was expected to overload the site; therefore Google rescheduled the crawl.

rules.name: Soft 404
rules.question: ¿Google trata la URL como soft 404?
rules.pass_if: No.
rules.fail_if: Soft 404 / empty / thin que parece error.
rules.official_quote: A soft 404 error is when a URL that returns a page telling the user that the page does not exist and also a 200 (success) status code. In some cases, it might be a page with no main content or empty page.

rules.name: Duplicate, Google chose different canonical
rules.question: ¿Google eligió otra canonical?
rules.pass_if: No, o es el cluster intencional.
rules.fail_if: Canibalización / Google eligió otra URL.
rules.remediation: Consolidar o diferenciar de verdad el MC.
rules.official_quote: This page is marked as canonical for a set of pages, but Google thinks another URL makes a better canonical. Google has indexed the page that we consider canonical rather than this one.

rules.name: Alternate page with proper canonical
rules.question: ¿Es una versión alternativa (AMP, móvil/escritorio) con canonical correcto?
rules.pass_if: Sí y es intencional → pass.
rules.fail_if: Alternate no intencional.
rules.remediation: Si es intencional: n/a. Si no: unificar.
rules.official_quote: This page correctly points to the canonical page, which is indexed, so there is nothing you need to do. Alternate language pages are not detected by Search Console.

rules.name: Información original
rules.question: ¿Aporta reporting, research, análisis o datos originales?
rules.pass_if: Hay un hecho, dato, método o análisis propio, no solo lo que ya dice cualquier otra fuente.
rules.fail_if: Solo reúne lo que ya dicen otros sitios, sin nada propio.
rules.remediation: Agregar research propio, datos, o no publicar.
rules.official_quote: Does the content provide original information, reporting, research, or analysis?

rules.name: Sustancial y completo
rules.question: ¿La descripción del tema es sustancial, completa o exhaustiva?
rules.pass_if: Cubre el intent sin huecos obvios.
rules.fail_if: Superficial, lista genérica, no cierra el tema.
rules.remediation: Completar huecos o fusionar con una URL mejor.
rules.official_quote: Does the content provide a substantial, complete, or comprehensive description of the topic?

rules.name: Más allá de lo obvio
rules.question: ¿Hay insights que no son de sentido común?
rules.pass_if: Hay observación no trivial.
rules.fail_if: Solo tips obvios que escribiría cualquier LLM.
rules.remediation: Aportar el 'por qué nos pasó / lo que medimos / lo que no dicen todos'.
rules.official_quote: Does the content provide insightful analysis or interesting information that is beyond the obvious?

rules.name: Valor extra vs fuentes
rules.question: Si usa fuentes, ¿aporta valor adicional sustancial?
rules.pass_if: Sintetiza + añade algo propio.
rules.fail_if: Rewrite / traducción / paráfrasis.
rules.remediation: Reescribir con valor o citar y no publicar.
rules.official_quote: If the content draws on other sources, does it avoid simply copying or rewriting those sources, and instead provide substantial additional value and originality?

rules.name: Title/H1 descriptivo
rules.question: ¿El título resume el contenido de forma útil?
rules.pass_if: Title y H1 describen el MC.
rules.fail_if: Title vago, keyword-only o desconectado.
rules.official_quote: Does the main heading or page title provide a descriptive, helpful summary of the content?

rules.name: Title no clickbait
rules.question: ¿El título evita exagerar o ser shocking?
rules.pass_if: Sin promesas infladas.
rules.fail_if: Clickbait, shock, 'no vas a creer'.
rules.remediation: Bajar el tono al contenido real.
rules.official_quote: Does the main heading or page title avoid exaggerating or being shocking in nature?

rules.name: ¿La guardarías?
rules.question: ¿Es el tipo de página que guardarías, compartirías o recomendarías?
rules.pass_if: Sí, con honestidad.
rules.fail_if: No hay motivo para volver ni compartir.
rules.remediation: Subir utilidad práctica o punto de vista.
rules.official_quote: Is this the sort of page you'd want to bookmark, share with a friend, or recommend?

rules.name: Nivel publicación seria
rules.question: ¿La verías en una revista, enciclopedia o libro?
rules.pass_if: Calidad editorial reconocible.
rules.fail_if: Relleno de blog farm.
rules.official_quote: Would you expect to see this content in or referenced by a printed magazine, encyclopedia, or book?

rules.name: Valor vs SERP
rules.question: ¿Aporta valor sustancial comparado con otras páginas del resultado?
rules.pass_if: Aporta algo útil que un resumen genérico del tema no tendría.
rules.fail_if: Equivale a un resumen genérico del tema, sin nada que no esté en cualquier otra página.
rules.remediation: Diferenciarse con first-hand o no competir esa query.
rules.official_quote: Does the content provide substantial value when compared to other pages in search results?

rules.name: Ortografía y estilo
rules.question: ¿Está limpio a nivel idioma?
rules.pass_if: Sin errores sistemáticos.
rules.fail_if: Typos, machine-translation cruda, estilo roto.
rules.official_quote: Does the content have any spelling or stylistic issues?

rules.name: No sloppy
rules.question: ¿Está bien producido o parece apresurado?
rules.pass_if: Cuidado editorial visible.
rules.fail_if: Plantilla a medias, headings huérfanos, placeholders.
rules.remediation: Terminar la página o no publicarla.
rules.official_quote: Is the content produced well, or does it appear sloppy or hastily produced?

rules.name: No mass-produced
rules.question: ¿Se le dedicó atención real a ESTA página?
rules.pass_if: Cuidado específico de esta URL.
rules.fail_if: Salida de fábrica / red de sitios / outsource sin edición.
rules.remediation: Bajar volumen, subir edición. Site-level si es patrón.
rules.official_quote: Is the content mass-produced by or outsourced to a large number of creators, or spread across a large network of sites, so that individual pages or sites don't get as much attention or care?

rules.name: Señales de confianza visibles
rules.question: ¿Hay fuentes, evidencia de expertise, author page o About?
rules.pass_if: Se entiende quién respalda lo que se dice.
rules.fail_if: Anónimo, sin fuentes, sin About.
rules.remediation: Mostrar fuentes y quién está detrás (autor o About) y su experiencia, en la medida en que el lector lo esperaría.
rules.official_quote: Does the content present information in a way that makes you want to trust it, such as clear sourcing, evidence of the expertise involved, background about the author or the site that publishes it, such as through links to an author page or a site's About page?

rules.name: El sitio parece autoridad en el tema
rules.question: Si alguien investiga el sitio, ¿parece autoridad en ESTE tema?
rules.pass_if: El sitio o sus autores tienen trayectoria o reputación visible en este tema.
rules.fail_if: Nada muestra reputación ni trayectoria en este tema.
rules.remediation: Construir reputación real en el tema (archivo, autores, menciones) o no cubrirlo.
rules.official_quote: If someone researched the site producing the content, would they come away with an impression that it is well-trusted or widely-recognized as an authority on its topic?

rules.name: Escrito o revisado por quien conoce el tema
rules.question: ¿Lo escribió o revisó un experto/entusiasta demostrable?
rules.pass_if: Autor o reviewer con background acorde.
rules.fail_if: Nadie identificable o autor de otro rubro sin ayuda.
rules.official_quote: Is this content written or reviewed by an expert or enthusiast who demonstrably knows the topic well?

rules.name: Sin errores factuales fáciles
rules.question: ¿Hay errores de hecho fáciles de verificar?
rules.pass_if: No.
rules.fail_if: Sí (fechas, cifras, nombres, consenso).
rules.remediation: Fact-check humano. En YMYL → tratar como critical.
rules.official_quote: Does the content have any easily-verified factual errors?

rules.name: Audiencia real
rules.question: ¿Hay una audiencia que lo usaría si llegara directo, sin Search?
rules.pass_if: Sí: clientes, comunidad, lectores del sitio.
rules.fail_if: Solo existe para capturar queries.
rules.remediation: Matchear con el propósito del negocio o no publicar.
rules.official_quote: Do you have an existing or intended audience for your business or site that would find the content useful if they came directly to you?

rules.name: First-hand visible
rules.question: ¿Se ve experiencia de primera mano y profundidad?
rules.pass_if: Se ve experiencia de primera mano (usó el producto, estuvo ahí, midió), o la página no pretende tenerla (listados, documentación, categorías).
rules.fail_if: Pretende experiencia (review, guía práctica) y no hay nada que un modelo no podría inventar.
rules.remediation: Agregar evidencia real o no pretender review/guía experta.
rules.official_quote: Does your content clearly demonstrate first-hand expertise and a depth of knowledge (for example, expertise that comes from having actually used a product or service, or visiting a place)?

rules.name: El sitio tiene foco
rules.question: ¿El sitio tiene un propósito o foco primario?
rules.pass_if: Temática coherente.
rules.fail_if: Granja de temas no relacionados.
rules.official_quote: Does your site have a primary purpose or focus?

rules.name: El lector logra su objetivo
rules.question: ¿Se va pudiendo hacer lo que vino a hacer?
rules.pass_if: La página cierra el intent.
rules.fail_if: Deja huecos que obligan a seguir buscando.
rules.official_quote: After reading your content, will someone leave feeling they've learned enough about a topic to help achieve their goal?

rules.name: Experiencia satisfactoria
rules.question: ¿La lectura es una experiencia satisfactoria?
rules.pass_if: Clara, útil, sin trampa.
rules.fail_if: Frustración, ads, bait, vacío.
rules.official_quote: Will someone reading your content leave feeling like they've had a satisfying experience?

rules.name: Hecha para buscadores
rules.question: ¿El contenido se hizo principalmente para atraer visitas de Search?
rules.pass_if: El propósito primario es ayudar a una audiencia: sería útil si alguien llegara directo.
rules.fail_if: La página misma muestra que existe para captar tráfico de Search (p. ej. cubre un cluster de queries sin ayudar a nadie).
rules.remediation: Replantear Why o matar la URL.
rules.official_quote: Is the content primarily made to attract visits from search engines?

rules.name: Muchos temas por si alguno rankea
rules.question: ¿Producís lots of content on many different topics hoping some ranks?
rules.pass_if: Temas del foco del sitio.
rules.fail_if: Scatter temático a escala.
rules.official_quote: Are you producing lots of content on many different topics in hopes that some of it might perform well in search results?

rules.name: Automatización extensiva multi-tema
rules.question: ¿Usás automatización extensiva para producir contenido en muchos temas?
rules.pass_if: Automatización, si existe, es asistencia + edición en el foco.
rules.fail_if: Fábrica multi-nicho.
rules.official_quote: Are you using extensive automation to produce content on many topics?

rules.name: Solo resume a otros
rules.question: ¿Principalmente resume lo que dicen otros sin valor?
rules.pass_if: Aporta algo propio.
rules.fail_if: Sí.
rules.official_quote: Are you mainly summarizing what others have to say without adding much value?

rules.name: Trending que no escribirían
rules.question: ¿Lo escribís solo porque está trending?
rules.pass_if: Lo escribirían igual para su audiencia.
rules.fail_if: Trend chasing.
rules.official_quote: Are you writing about things simply because they seem trending and not because you'd write about them otherwise for your existing audience?

rules.name: El lector vuelve a Google
rules.question: ¿El lector necesita buscar de nuevo para obtener mejor info?
rules.pass_if: No.
rules.fail_if: Sí.
rules.remediation: Completar o no competir esa query.
rules.official_quote: Does your content leave readers feeling like they need to search again to get better information from other sources?

rules.name: Word count target
rules.question: ¿Se escribió a N palabras porque 'Google prefiere X'?
rules.pass_if: Largo = el que necesita el tema.
rules.fail_if: Relleno evidente que alarga el texto sin aportar (padding).
rules.remediation: Cortar relleno. Google no tiene word count preferido.
rules.official_quote: Are you writing to a particular word count because you've heard or read that Google has a preferred word count? (No, we don't.)

rules.name: Nicho sin expertise por tráfico
rules.question: ¿Entraron al tema sin expertise real, solo por tráfico?
rules.pass_if: Hay expertise o experiencia.
rules.fail_if: Turismo de keywords.
rules.remediation: No cubrir el tema o traer experto.
rules.official_quote: Did you decide to enter some niche topic area without any real expertise, but instead mainly because you thought you'd get search traffic?

rules.name: Respuesta que no existe
rules.question: ¿Promete una respuesta que no existe (fecha no confirmada, etc.)?
rules.pass_if: No inventa.
rules.fail_if: Promete lo que no hay.
rules.remediation: Sacar la promesa o no publicar.
rules.official_quote: Does your content promise to answer a question that actually has no answer, such as suggesting there's a release date for a product, movie, or TV show when one isn't confirmed?

rules.name: Fecha falseada
rules.question: ¿Se cambió la fecha para parecer fresh sin cambio sustancial?
rules.pass_if: Fecha = cambio real o no se toca.
rules.fail_if: Cosmetic date bump.
rules.remediation: Revertir fecha o hacer update real.
rules.official_quote: Are you changing the date of pages to make them seem fresh when the content has not substantially changed?

rules.name: Altas/bajas para parecer fresh
rules.question: ¿Se agrega o borra masivamente solo para que el sitio 'parezca fresco'?
rules.pass_if: Cambios editoriales reales.
rules.fail_if: Churn cosmético.
rules.remediation: Parar. Google dice que no ayuda rankings.
rules.official_quote: Are you adding a lot of new content or removing a lot of older content primarily because you believe it will help your search rankings overall by somehow making your site seem "fresh?" (No, it won't)

rules.name: Autor evidente
rules.question: ¿Es evidente quién creó el contenido, donde un lector lo esperaría?
rules.pass_if: Identidad clara (byline, autor en schema o firma del equipo), o es un tipo de página donde nadie espera byline (categoría, ficha, herramienta).
rules.fail_if: Artículo, noticia, review o contenido YMYL sin ninguna autoría donde el lector preguntaría quién lo escribió.
rules.remediation: Agregar byline con autor real donde el lector lo esperaría.
rules.official_quote: Is it self-evident to your visitors who authored your content?

rules.name: Byline lleva a bio
rules.question: ¿El byline abre background del autor y sus temas?
rules.pass_if: Author page con bio y foco.
rules.fail_if: Nombre muerto sin contexto.
rules.official_quote: Do bylines lead to further information about the author or authors involved, giving background about them and the areas they write about?

rules.name: Cómo se produjo
rules.question: ¿Se entiende cómo se hizo el contenido cuando importa?
rules.pass_if: Método / evidencia / proceso visible si el lector lo esperaría.
rules.fail_if: Afirmaciones sin método en reviews o YMYL.
rules.official_quote: It's helpful to readers to know how a piece of content was produced: this is the "How" to consider including in your content.

rules.name: Disclosure de IA si aplica
rules.question: Si la automatización genera una parte sustancial, ¿es razonable que el lector lo sepa?
rules.pass_if: Disclosure u otra forma evidente cuando alguien preguntaría 'how was this created?'.
rules.fail_if: Una parte sustancial parece generada automáticamente y no hay ninguna explicación de cómo se produjo, en un contexto donde el lector lo preguntaría.
rules.remediation: Agregar contexto de proceso. No poner a la IA como autor.
rules.official_quote: Overall, AI or automation disclosures are useful for content where someone might think "How was this created?" Consider adding these when it would be reasonably expected.

rules.name: Por qué se usó IA
rules.question: ¿Se explica por qué la IA fue útil?
rules.pass_if: Hay razón editorial (estructura, research assist) + edición humana.
rules.fail_if: Usa IA o automatización de forma sustancial sin explicar su rol, donde el lector lo esperaría.
rules.remediation: Explicar qué hizo la automatización y qué hizo una persona.
rules.official_quote: Are you explaining why automation or AI was seen as useful to produce content?

rules.name: Experience
rules.question: ¿Hay evidencia de experiencia de primera mano?
rules.pass_if: Hay evidencia de experiencia de primera mano, o el propósito de la página no la requiere.
rules.fail_if: Declara experiencia sin ninguna evidencia, o su propósito (review, guía práctica) la requiere y no aparece.
rules.remediation: Agregar evidencia real o bajar pretensión.
rules.official_quote: Does your content clearly demonstrate first-hand expertise and a depth of knowledge (for example, expertise that comes from having actually used a product or service, or visiting a place)?

rules.name: Expertise
rules.question: ¿El nivel de conocimiento es el que el tema pide?
rules.pass_if: Acorde (formal o informal).
rules.fail_if: Tema experto tratado por amateur sin ayuda.
rules.remediation: Sumar a alguien con conocimiento del tema como autor o revisor, o acotar el alcance.
rules.official_quote: Expertise: Consider the extent to which the content creator has the necessary knowledge or skill for the topic. Different topics require different levels and types of expertise to be trustworthy.

rules.name: Trust (la más importante)
rules.question: ¿Se puede confiar en la página y el sitio?
rules.pass_if: Exacta, transparente sobre quién está detrás, sin engaño.
rules.fail_if: Engaño activo: información falsa sobre el negocio, el autor o el contenido, trampas o estafa.
rules.remediation: Corregir hechos, mostrar quiénes son, sacar trampas.
rules.official_quote: Of these aspects, trust is most important. The others contribute to trust, but content doesn't necessarily have to demonstrate all of them.

rules.name: Author no es 'AI'
rules.question: ¿El byline es una persona o un equipo real?
rules.pass_if: Autor humano/equipo.
rules.fail_if: Byline = ChatGPT / 'AI Writer'.
rules.remediation: Autor humano. Disclosure de proceso aparte.
rules.official_quote: Giving AI an author byline is probably not the best way to follow our recommendation to make clear to readers when AI is part of the content creation process.

rules.name: About / contacto / ownership
rules.question: ¿Se entiende quién opera el sitio?
rules.pass_if: Se puede saber quién opera el sitio o cómo contactarlo (About o contacto).
rules.fail_if: Ni About ni contacto: no hay forma de saber quién está detrás.
rules.official_quote: Does the content present information in a way that makes you want to trust it, such as clear sourcing, evidence of the expertise involved, background about the author or the site that publishes it, such as through links to an author page or a site's About page?

rules.name: Umbral extra si YMYL
rules.question: Si es YMYL, ¿el nivel de expertise y fuentes es el que el tema exige?
rules.pass_if: Expertise visible (autor o revisor calificado, fuentes primarias), o experiencia personal segura y alineada al consenso cuando no pretende dar consejo experto.
rules.fail_if: Da consejo experto en un tema YMYL sin ninguna señal de expertise ni fuentes.
rules.remediation: Sumar autor o revisor calificado y fuentes primarias, o acotar a experiencia personal.
rules.official_quote: For example, our systems give even more weight to content that aligns with strong E-E-A-T for topics that could significantly impact the health, financial stability, or safety of people, or the welfare or well-being of society.

rules.name: No contradecir consenso establecido
rules.question: ¿Contradice consenso bien establecido en temas críticos?
rules.pass_if: No, o discute el debate con sources.
rules.fail_if: Sí, sin evidencia seria.
rules.remediation: Alinear a fuentes primarias o matar la URL.
rules.official_quote: However content is produced, our systems look to surface high-quality information from reliable sources, and not information that contradicts well-established consensus on important topics.

rules.name: PQ no Lowest por MC vacío de valor
rules.question: ¿El MC tiene al menos algo de esfuerzo, originalidad o valor añadido?
rules.pass_if: Al menos uno de esfuerzo, originalidad o valor añadido está claramente presente.
rules.fail_if: Casi todo el MC es copiado, parafraseado o generado automáticamente con poco o ningún esfuerzo, originalidad y valor añadido a la vez.
rules.official_quote: The Lowest rating applies if all or almost all of the MC on the page (including text, images, audio, videos, etc) is copied, paraphrased, embedded, auto or AI generated, or reposted from other sources with little to no effort, little to no originality, and little to no added value for visitors to the website.

rules.name: Cloaking
rules.question: ¿El contenido para Googlebot es el mismo que para el usuario?
rules.pass_if: Mismo contenido para Googlebot y para usuarios, o paywall que muestra el contenido completo a Google siguiendo Flexible Sampling.
rules.fail_if: Contenido distinto a buscadores y usuarios para manipular rankings.
rules.official_quote: Cloaking refers to the practice of presenting different content to users and search engines with the intent to manipulate search rankings and mislead users.

rules.name: Doorway abuse
rules.question: ¿Hay páginas near-duplicate hechas para queries similares que funnel a lo mismo?
rules.pass_if: No.
rules.fail_if: Es una de varias páginas o dominios sustancialmente similares creados para rankear por queries parecidas (p. ej. variantes por ciudad) que llevan a una página intermedia menos útil o funnelean a un mismo destino.
rules.official_quote: Doorway abuse is when sites or pages are created to rank for specific, similar search queries. They lead users to intermediate pages that aren't as useful as the final destination.

rules.name: Expired domain abuse
rules.question: ¿Se compró un dominio expirado para reutilizarlo sobre todo para manipular rankings?
rules.pass_if: No.
rules.fail_if: Dominio expirado reutilizado principalmente para rankear con contenido de poco o ningún valor (p. ej. afiliados en un ex-sitio de gobierno).
rules.official_quote: Expired domain abuse is where an expired domain name is purchased and repurposed primarily to manipulate search rankings by hosting content that provides little to no value to users.

rules.name: Hacked content
rules.question: ¿Hay páginas hackeadas / spam inyectado?
rules.pass_if: No.
rules.fail_if: Sí.
rules.official_quote: Hacked content is any content placed on a site without permission, due to vulnerabilities in a site's security. Hacked content gives poor search results to our users and can potentially install malicious content on their machines.

rules.name: Hidden text / links
rules.question: ¿Hay texto o links escondidos para manipular?
rules.pass_if: No hay texto ni links ocultos para manipular. Acordeones, pestañas, sliders, tooltips y texto solo para lectores de pantalla NO cuentan.
rules.fail_if: Texto o links ocultos a los usuarios para manipular rankings (color igual al fondo, off-screen, tamaño 0).
rules.official_quote: Hidden text or link abuse is the practice of placing content on a page in a way solely to manipulate search engines and not to be easily viewable by human visitors.

rules.name: Keyword stuffing
rules.question: ¿Hay repetición no natural de keywords?
rules.pass_if: Lenguaje natural.
rules.fail_if: Stuffing.
rules.official_quote: Keyword stuffing refers to the practice of filling a web page with keywords or numbers in an attempt to manipulate rankings in Google Search results. Often these keywords appear in a list or group, unnaturally, or out of context.

rules.name: Link spam
rules.question: ¿Hay compra/intercambio/PBN/footer keyword links?
rules.pass_if: Perfil natural.
rules.fail_if: Compra, venta o intercambio de links para rankear, PBN, links de keyword en footers/plantillas, o links pagados/advertorial sin rel="sponsored" o nofollow.
rules.official_quote: Link spam is the practice of creating links to or from a site primarily for the purpose of manipulating search rankings.

rules.name: Malicious practices
rules.question: ¿Hay malware, software no deseado, back button hijacking u otra práctica maliciosa?
rules.pass_if: No.
rules.fail_if: Malware o software no deseado, o manipulación del historial que impide volver con el botón atrás (back button hijacking, vigente desde el 15-jun-2026).
rules.official_quote: Malicious practices create a mismatch between user expectations and the actual outcome, leading to a negative and deceptive user experience, or compromised user security or privacy.

rules.name: Misleading functionality
rules.question: ¿Dice ofrecer una herramienta o servicio que en realidad no provee?
rules.pass_if: Lo que la página dice ofrecer está disponible.
rules.fail_if: Promete una herramienta o servicio (generador, conversor, descarga) que no provee y lleva al usuario a ads o contenido engañoso.
rules.official_quote: Misleading functionality refers to the practice of intentionally creating sites that trick users into thinking they would be able to access some content or services but in reality can't.

rules.name: Scraped content
rules.question: ¿Republica contenido ajeno sin valor extra?
rules.pass_if: Original o valor claro + atribución.
rules.fail_if: Copia contenido de otros sitios (literal o con sinónimos/técnicas automáticas) sin valor añadido sustancial.
rules.official_quote: Scraping refers to the practice of taking content from other sites, often through automated means, and hosting it with the purpose of manipulating search rankings.

rules.name: Scaled content abuse
rules.question: ¿Se generaron muchas páginas con poco valor original para manipular rankings (IA, humano o mixto)?
rules.pass_if: Cada URL tiene valor único y propósito people-first.
rules.fail_if: Fábrica de páginas commodity.
rules.remediation: Parar escala. Reescribir las que merezcan. Noindex/eliminar el resto.
rules.official_quote: Scaled content abuse is when many pages are generated for the primary purpose of manipulating search rankings and not helping users. This abusive practice is typically focused on creating large amounts of unoriginal content that provides little to no value to users, no matter how it's created.

rules.name: Site reputation policy
rules.question: ¿Hay contenido de terceros publicado sobre todo para aprovechar las señales de ranking del host?
rules.pass_if: No hay contenido de terceros, o está plenamente integrado: presentación coherente, calidad a la par del sitio, autoría y responsabilidad editorial claras.
rules.fail_if: Contenido de terceros (incluido freelance o white-label) publicado principalmente para aprovechar las señales de ranking del host, sin integración real.
rules.official_quote: The site reputation policy applies where third-party content is published on a host site mainly because of that host's already-established ranking signals, which it has earned primarily from its first-party content.

rules.name: Sneaky redirects
rules.question: ¿Hay redirects que muestran a los usuarios algo distinto de lo que ven los buscadores o de lo que esperaban?
rules.pass_if: Redirects honestos.
rules.fail_if: Redirige a usuarios a contenido distinto del que ven los buscadores o del que esperaban (p. ej. usuarios móviles a un dominio spam).
rules.official_quote: Redirecting is the act of sending a visitor to a different URL than the one they initially requested. Sneaky redirecting is the practice of doing this maliciously in order to either show users and search engines different content or show users unexpected content that doesn't fulfill their original needs.

rules.name: Thin affiliation
rules.question: ¿Es copy de merchant + links de afiliado sin valor?
rules.pass_if: Aporta valor propio: reviews originales, testing, ratings, comparación de precios o productos, o navegación útil.
rules.fail_if: Copia descripciones del merchant con links de afiliado, sin valor añadido, a veces replicado en una red de sitios.
rules.official_quote: Thin affiliation is the practice of publishing content with product affiliate links where the product descriptions and reviews are copied directly from the original merchant without any original content or added value.

rules.name: UGC spam
rules.question: ¿Comentarios/foros están moderados?
rules.pass_if: UGC moderado; links de usuarios con rel="ugc" o nofollow.
rules.fail_if: Spam visible en comentarios, foros o perfiles.
rules.official_quote: User-generated spam is spammy content added to a site by users through a channel intended for user content. Often site owners are unaware of the spammy content.

rules.name: Manipular respuestas de IA
rules.question: ¿El contenido está diseñado para engañar AI Overviews / AI Mode (prompt-injection, fake authority, listicles sesgados para el modelo)?
rules.pass_if: Útil para personas; si aparece en respuestas de IA es consecuencia.
rules.fail_if: Técnicas concretas para manipular respuestas de IA: instrucciones ocultas o prompt-injection, contenido servido solo a bots, o citas y autoridad fabricadas.
rules.remediation: Quitar la manipulación y escribir para personas.
rules.official_quote: In the context of Google Search, spam refers to techniques used to deceive users or manipulate our Search systems into featuring content prominently, such as attempting to manipulate Search systems into ranking content highly or attempting to manipulate generative AI responses in Google Search.

rules.name: Scam and fraud
rules.question: ¿La página suplanta a un negocio o servicio oficial o muestra información falsa sobre un negocio o servicio?
rules.pass_if: Se presenta como quien es; la información del negocio es veraz.
rules.fail_if: Suplanta un negocio o servicio oficial, muestra datos falsos del negocio o soporte/contacto falso para atraer usuarios con engaño.
rules.remediation: Quitar la suplantación y la información falsa.
rules.official_quote: Scam and fraud come in many forms, including but not limited to impersonating an official business or service through imposter sites, intentionally displaying false information about a business or service, or otherwise attracting users to a site on false pretenses.

rules.name: Policy circumvention
rules.question: ¿El sitio intenta eludir acciones o políticas de Google (p. ej. subdominios o dominios nuevos para seguir con lo sancionado)?
rules.pass_if: No.
rules.fail_if: Crea sitios, subdominios u otros métodos para seguir distribuyendo contenido que ya violó las políticas.
rules.remediation: Corregir la violación original en vez de moverla.
rules.official_quote: If a site continues to engage in actions intended to bypass our spam policies or content policies for Google Search, we may take appropriate action which may include restricting or removing eligibility for some of our search features (for example, Top Stories, Discover) and taking broader action in Google Search (for example, removing more sections of a site from Search results).

rules.name: Contenido generado revisado
rules.question: ¿El contenido generado automáticamente es exacto, de calidad y relevante?
rules.pass_if: No hay errores, incoherencias ni relleno genérico que delaten salida sin revisar.
rules.fail_if: Errores factuales, incoherencias o texto genérico típicos de salida automática sin revisar.
rules.remediation: Revisar exactitud, calidad y relevancia antes de publicar.
rules.official_quote: When creating content for the web, focus on accuracy, quality, and relevance, especially when automatically generating the content.

rules.name: No una URL por cada fan-out
rules.question: ¿Es una de muchas URLs casi idénticas, una por variante de query (fan-out)?
rules.pass_if: La URL tiene valor propio; si hay variantes, cada una aporta algo distinto.
rules.fail_if: Es una de varias URLs casi idénticas creadas por cada variante de query, sin valor propio, para manipular rankings o respuestas de IA.
rules.official_quote: While it might be tempting to create separate content for every possible variation of how people might search (for example, by focusing on other queries that people have asked, or fan-out queries), doing so primarily to manipulate rankings or generative AI responses in Google Search violates Google's scaled content abuse spam policy.

rules.name: Metadata no alucinada
rules.question: ¿Title, meta, alt y schema son precisos?
rules.pass_if: Sí y coinciden con el MC.
rules.fail_if: Alucinaciones en metadata.
rules.official_quote: This includes metadata like <title> elements, meta description elements, structured data, and alternate texts for images, which can appear in Search results.

rules.name: Ecommerce imágenes IA etiquetadas
rules.question: ¿Las imágenes IA tienen IPTC DigitalSourceType=TrainedAlgorithmicMedia?
rules.pass_if: Sí.
rules.fail_if: No.
rules.official_quote: In particular, AI-generated images must contain metadata using the IPTC DigitalSourceType TrainedAlgorithmicMedia metadata.

rules.name: Product data IA etiquetada
rules.question: ¿Títulos/descripciones de producto generados por IA están labeled?
rules.pass_if: Sí.
rules.fail_if: No.
rules.official_quote: AI-generated product data such as title and description attributes must be specified separately and labeled as AI-generated.

rules.name: No chunking artificial
rules.question: ¿Se partió el contenido en trozos minúsculos 'para la IA'?
rules.pass_if: Estructura pensada para lectores. Partir en secciones no es requisito ni penaliza por sí solo.
rules.fail_if: Fragmentación artificial que empeora la lectura, hecha 'para la IA'.
rules.official_quote: There's no requirement to break your content into tiny pieces for AI to better understand it. Google systems are able to understand the nuance of multiple topics on a page and show the relevant piece to users.

rules.name: No menciones inauténticas
rules.question: ¿Se fabricaron mentions para aparecer en AI Overviews?
rules.pass_if: No.
rules.fail_if: Sí.
rules.official_quote: However, seeking inauthentic "mentions" across the web isn't as helpful as it might seem.

rules.name: Indexada + snippet eligible
rules.question: ¿La URL está indexada y es eligible a snippet?
rules.pass_if: Sí.
rules.fail_if: No indexada / nosnippet.
rules.remediation: Cumplir TECH + quitar nosnippet si se quiere aparecer.
rules.official_quote: To be eligible to be shown as a supporting link in AI Overviews or AI Mode, a page must be indexed and eligible to be shown in Google Search with a snippet, fulfilling the Search technical requirements.

rules.name: HTTPS
rules.question: ¿Se sirve por HTTPS?
rules.pass_if: Sí.
rules.fail_if: HTTP.
rules.official_quote: Are your pages served in a secure fashion?

rules.name: Mobile-friendly
rules.question: ¿Se lee y usa bien en móvil?
rules.pass_if: Sí.
rules.fail_if: Texto corte / tap targets imposibles.
rules.official_quote: Does your content display well on mobile devices?

rules.name: LCP ≤ 2.5s
rules.question: ¿LCP en zona good?
rules.pass_if: LCP ≤ 2.5 s en datos de campo (p75).
rules.fail_if: LCP pobre.
rules.official_quote: To provide a good user experience, strive to have LCP occur within the first 2.5 seconds of the page starting to load.

rules.name: INP ≤ 200 ms
rules.question: ¿INP good?
rules.pass_if: INP ≤ 200 ms en datos de campo (p75).
rules.fail_if: INP pobre.
rules.official_quote: Measures responsiveness. To provide a good user experience, strive to have an INP of less than 200 milliseconds.

rules.name: CLS estable
rules.question: ¿CLS good?
rules.pass_if: CLS ≤ 0.1 en datos de campo (p75).
rules.fail_if: Layout shift.
rules.official_quote: Measures visual stability. To provide a good user experience, strive to have a CLS score of less than 0.1.

rules.name: MC distinguible, sin interstitial agresivo ni ads que lo tapen
rules.question: ¿El lector distingue el MC y puede leerlo?
rules.pass_if: MC claro, ads no lo entierran, sin interstitial intrusivo.
rules.fail_if: Ads/interstitial tapan el contenido.
rules.official_quote: Does your content avoid using an excessive amount of ads that distract from or interfere with the main content? Do your pages avoid using intrusive interstitials? Is your page designed so visitors can easily distinguish the main content from other content on your page?

rules.name: Evidencia first-hand
rules.question: ¿Hay fotos/audio/mediciones del uso real?
rules.pass_if: Evidencia propia.
rules.fail_if: Review de ficha técnica.
rules.remediation: Usar el producto o no hacer review.
rules.official_quote: Provide evidence such as visuals, audio, or other links of your own experience with what you are reviewing, to support your expertise and reinforce the authenticity of your review.

rules.name: Pros y contras originales
rules.question: ¿Hay pros/contras de research propio?
rules.pass_if: Sí.
rules.fail_if: Brochure del fabricante.
rules.official_quote: Discuss the benefits and drawbacks of something, based on your own original research.

rules.name: Vs competidores
rules.question: ¿Explica qué lo diferencia y para qué uso es mejor?
rules.pass_if: Sí.
rules.fail_if: No hay comparación útil.
rules.official_quote: Explain what sets something apart from its competitors. Cover comparable things to consider, or explain which might be best for certain uses or circumstances.

rules.name: Mediciones cuantitativas
rules.question: ¿Hay números propios de performance cuando aplica?
rules.pass_if: Sí o n/a si el producto no se presta.
rules.fail_if: Solo adjetivos.
rules.official_quote: Share quantitative measurements about how something measures up in various categories of performance.

rules.name: Best-of se sostiene solo
rules.question: Si es un ranking, ¿cada ítem tiene contenido útil suficiente?
rules.pass_if: Sí.
rules.fail_if: Los ítems no tienen contenido útil suficiente para sostenerse solos.
rules.official_quote: Ensure there is enough useful content in your ranked lists for them to stand on their own, even if you choose to write separate in-depth single reviews.

rules.name: Schema = contenido visible
rules.question: ¿El JSON-LD describe solo lo visible?
rules.pass_if: Sí.
rules.fail_if: Markup de cosas que el lector no ve.
rules.official_quote: Don't mark up content that is not visible to readers of the page. For example, if the JSON-LD markup describes a performer, the HTML body must describe that same performer.

rules.name: No reviews falsas en schema
rules.question: ¿Hay reviews o ratings falsos, o incentivados sin disclosure?
rules.pass_if: No.
rules.fail_if: Review/aggregateRating sin reviews visibles, o reviews falsas o incentivadas sin disclosure, en la página o en el markup.
rules.remediation: Sacar el markup falso y mostrar solo reviews reales, declarando los incentivos.
rules.official_quote: Don't include fake or undisclosed incentivized reviews on your page or in your structured data markup.

rules.name: No markup irrelevante o engañoso
rules.question: ¿El tipo de schema corresponde a la página?
rules.pass_if: Sí.
rules.fail_if: Article marcado como Product / FAQ inventada / autor falso.
rules.official_quote: Don't mark up irrelevant or misleading content, such as fake reviews or content unrelated to the focus of a page. Don't use structured data to deceive or mislead users.

rules.name: Info actualizada
rules.question: ¿El schema no describe algo time-sensitive ya viejo como si fuera actual?
rules.pass_if: Fechas coherentes.
rules.fail_if: Evento pasado marcado como vigente.
rules.official_quote: Provide up-to-date information. We won't show a rich result for time-sensitive content that is no longer relevant.

rules.name: Title único
rules.question: ¿El title es único y no boilerplate?
rules.pass_if: Único.
rules.fail_if: Title repetido en el sitio.
rules.official_quote: Avoid repeated or boilerplate text in <title> elements. It's important to have distinct text that describes the content of the page in the <title> element for each page on your site.

rules.name: H1 claro
rules.question: ¿Hay un título principal claro y coherente con el MC?
rules.pass_if: Sí; no hace falta que coincida con el title.
rules.fail_if: H1 de plantilla o desconectado del contenido.
rules.official_quote: Consider ensuring that your main title is distinctive from other text on a page and stands out as being the most prominent on the page (for example, using a larger font, putting the title text in the first visible <h1> element on the page, etc).

rules.name: Alt text descriptivo
rules.question: ¿Las imágenes de contenido tienen alt útil?
rules.pass_if: Sí.
rules.fail_if: alt vacío o stuffing.
rules.official_quote: When writing alt text, focus on creating useful, information-rich content that uses keywords appropriately and is in context of the content of the page. Avoid filling alt attributes with keywords (also known as keyword stuffing) as it results in a negative user experience and may cause your site to be seen as spam.

rules.name: Anchor text descriptivo
rules.question: ¿Los anclas internas describen el destino?
rules.pass_if: Sí.
rules.fail_if: Click here / keyword stuffing.
rules.official_quote: Good anchor text is descriptive, reasonably concise, and relevant to the page that it's on and to the page it links to. It provides context for the link, and sets the expectation for your readers.

rules.name: No red clon
rules.question: ¿Forma parte de una red de sites con el mismo MC?
rules.pass_if: No.
rules.fail_if: Sí.
rules.official_quote: Is the content mass-produced by or outsourced to a large number of creators, or spread across a large network of sites, so that individual pages or sites don't get as much attention or care?

rules.name: Autores reales
rules.question: ¿Los contenidos donde el lector espera autor tienen autores reales?
rules.pass_if: Autores reales donde el lector lo esperaría.
rules.fail_if: Autores fantasma.
rules.official_quote: We strongly encourage adding accurate authorship information, such as bylines to content where readers might expect it.

rules.name: Fechas = updates reales
rules.question: ¿La política de fechas del sitio es honesta?
rules.pass_if: Updates sustanciales.
rules.fail_if: Date bump masivo.
rules.official_quote: Are you changing the date of pages to make them seem fresh when the content has not substantially changed?

rules.name: Thin ratio / crawled-not-indexed
rules.question: ¿El sitio tiene un % alto de URLs sin valor o no indexadas por calidad?
rules.pass_if: La mayoría de URLs publicadas merecen existir.
rules.fail_if: Biblioteca thin que ensucia señales de sitio.
rules.official_quote: In fact, if you're considering deleting entire sections of your site, that's likely a sign those sections were created for search engines first, and not people. If that's the case for your site, then deleting the unhelpful content can help the good content on your site perform better.
